g.text: 同样功率下，差别不在总能量，

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 而在功率怎么分配到频段：

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: start

g.text: PRBS 宽而平，多正弦窄而深，

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 阶跃集中在低频，白噪声最宽。
